---
title: "Downloads"
---

The tool installs from its repository with uv, which also installs the right version of Python:

```bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox@v0.1.0
```

Each tagged release also carries a wheel, for machines that install from a file:

| Version | Date | Wheel | Notes |
|:--|:--|:--|:----|
| 0.1.0 | Not released yet | `esa_toolbox-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` | First version, with crop pollination, wood provision and carbon sequestration |

: Releases. {#tbl-releases}

```bash
uv tool install ./esa_toolbox-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

The results themselves, the workbooks, maps and reports, are not downloads of the tool. Each run writes them to its own outputs
folder, and the report of a run names the tool version that made it.
